incentives.name: Strategic Investment Program (SIP)
incentives.what: 15-year partial property tax abatement on value above a taxable portion ($25M-$100M); community service fee = lesser of 25% of savings or $2.5M a year. Used by Amazon (Morrow 2023, Umatilla 2017) and Google (The Dalles).

incentives.name: Long-term rural enterprise zone (LRZ) and standard enterprise zones
incentives.what: New facility property exempt 7 to 15 years in rural zones, with hiring and pay rules and local payment deals. Ten data centers (Amazon Boardman, Apple and Facebook Prineville, Google The Dalles) were 94% of the $153M LRZ property tax impact in 2022-23. Standard 3-5 year exemptions used heavily by Hillsboro data centers. Oregon has no sales tax, so there is no sales tax exemption.
incentives.value_known: $153 million LRZ property tax impact in 2022-23 (all LRZ, 94% from data centers)

dockets.what: POWER Act (HB 3546) implementation: updated rate schedules; data centers in PGE territory now pay 29% more while residential, commercial and industrial rates fell. Data centers are about 15% of IOU load, expected 25% by 2030.
Investigation into PGE's new load connection costs and how to assign the risks and costs of connecting large customers.
Line extension allowance tariff: removes most of the line extension allowance for new customers over 25 MW.

dockets.id: Pacific Power POWER Act implementation (docket no. not found)
dockets.what: Pacific Power's large energy use facility class under the POWER Act, to be taken up fall 2026.

laws_and_bills.name: HB 3546 (2025) - POWER Act
laws_and_bills.what: Directs the PUC to create a separate service class for large energy use facilities (data centers) with tariffs that assign their costs to them, service contracts, and biennial reports to the Legislature; sunsets Jan 2, 2035. Oregon Laws 2025 ch. 323; emergency clause.

laws_and_bills.name: HB 4084 (2026), Oregon Laws 2026 ch. 50
laws_and_bills.what: Creates the Joint Permitting Council and fast-track permits, and bars new data centers from Enterprise Zone property tax breaks until 90 days after the 2027 session adjourns; existing and already-approved projects keep theirs; SIP still available. Moratorium effective June 5-6, 2026.

laws_and_bills.name: Proposed three-year moratorium on new large data centers (2027 session)
laws_and_bills.what: Sens. Jeff Golden and Courtney Neron Misslin and Reps. Lesly Munoz and Farrah Chaichi plan to propose a three-year statewide moratorium in the 2027 session; no bill number yet.

local_rules.what: Four-month (120-day) moratorium on new data centers plus a separate 120-day pause on high-capacity battery storage for data centers; unanimous, one day's notice; projects already permitted or building not affected.
Four-month moratorium on all data center applications regardless of size, until Jan 19, 2027; council may extend.
120-day freeze on accepting, reviewing and approving permits for new data storage, processing and IT facilities; no applications were pending. Clackamas County also considering a moratorium.
Governor stopped a data center company from buying Department of Corrections land in Salem (March 2026) and paused unapproved requests for data centers on state land.
